summary: Blue Moon Metals filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a press release dated October 6, 2026, reporting exploration assay results from an 18,000 m relogging campaign at its Springer Tungsten Mine in Imlay, Nevada. Approximately 77% of historical core has been relogged; drillhole NM-30 returned 0.3 m grading 7.84% WO, the second-highest grade on the property, while NM-45 confirmed 9.44 m grading 0.26% WO. ALS Geochemistry assays used QA/QC samples at roughly 12.5%. No transaction, corporate action, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved; this is routine operational disclosure.
